about:
ESCO Manufacturing is headquartered in Watertown, South Dakota. The company was founded in 1965 and has operated as a wholesale sign manufacturer for over half a century.

The company produces custom signs and channel letters, offering full-service manufacturing from design assistance through final production. Its capabilities include channel letter fabrication, custom cabinet production, face manufacturing, and church, school, and municipal signage. ESCO operates two dedicated facilities in South Dakota staffed by tenured professionals with decades of combined industry experience.

ESCO serves sign shops, electric sign companies, and municipal clients across the Midwest and beyond. Customer testimonials reference businesses such as JH Signs, All State Signs, Sandmann Signs & Electric, Indigo Signworks, AP Design, Total Motors, and Affordable Signs, indicating a wholesale customer base that relies on ESCO for channel letters, cabinets, and custom signage projects.

The company states its mission is to lead the sign industry by providing the best value in visual identification and advertising, built on strong work ethics and high business standards. It emphasizes craftsmanship, dependable service, a customer-first approach, and the deep experience of its long-standing team as key differentiators.
